gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Skeletal horror Teleport
• Fort Forinthry Teleport, then run east
• Varrock teleport, then run to the site
• Fairy ring (code CKS) near the entrance to Mort Myre Swamp, then go through the underground or take the level 65 Agility shortcut.
• Senntisten Teleport to the Varrock Dig Site with Ancient Magicks, then north, then east
• Dig Site pendant, then north, then east
• Bonesack (e) or ram skull helm (e), to Odd Old Man, then walk south (can only be done once a week, after completing the Fur 'n Seek wish list).
• Invitation box
